source: &637 Max...um...Dr Lao told me you'd be here, since you left the hospital.
target: &637 麦克斯……呃……劳博士说，你出院后会来这儿。

source: &638 Yeah...she said this was your...special place?
target: &638 嗯……她说，这里对你……很特别？

source: &639 I kinda know what that's like. I've got one of my own...
target: &639 我大概能理解。我也有个这样的地方……

source: &1802 Latha, I need to say it again...I'm sorry...
target: &1802 拉塔，我得再说一遍……对不起……

source: &642 But, Lao also told me what you did in the tower...
target: &642 不过，劳也告诉我，你在塔里做了什么……

source: &1803 It was the right thing to do.
&643 It was more than that! You almost DIED!
target: &643 不只是这样！你差点连命都没了！

source: &644 And...I think it goes a hell of a long way to making up for before.
target: &644 所以……我觉得，你已经弥补了很多。

source: &1804 We have a lot of catching up to do. How about we start again from scratch?
target: &1804 我们还有很多事要聊。不如从头认识一下？

source: &1805 Hi, I'm Charlie Regis. I'm a CEL agent, I have difficulty with change, and I'm apparently a father.
target: &1805 你好，我叫查理·里吉斯。是CEL探员，不太能适应变化，而且看来还是个父亲。

source: &645 Hey, I'm Latha. I'm a Trance-addict, and I've spent the last two years jobless.
target: &645 嗨，我叫拉塔。我有迷境瘾，过去两年一直没工作。

source: &646 I'd also like to learn about where I came from...
target: &646 我也想知道，自己究竟从哪里来……

source: &1806 Take a seat. Let me tell you about your mother...
target: &1806 坐吧。我跟你讲讲你母亲的事……
